_why: Pre-1985 coverage expansion: every NDA/BLA whose ORIGINAL submission was approved in 1980-1984, extracted per-record from the Drugs@FDA API with the same auditable ORIG+AP+date-in-year filter used for 1985-2026 (see scripts/openfda_decisions.py). Years 1983/1984 feed the pre1985_fda_decisions.csv expansion this session; 1980-1982 land the raw baseline for backward expansion in later sessions. Raw payloads are not committed (10-15 MB/year); the manifest records every request URL + SHA-256 so the extraction is reproducible.
